strings.AdbSync (riga di comando) — copia increm:
AdbSync (command line) — incremental phone → PC copy over ADB

Usage:
  adbsync-cli devices
  adbsync-cli compare  -r <phone folder> -l <PC folder> [options]
  adbsync-cli sync     -r <phone folder> -l <PC folder> [options] [--yes]
  adbsync-cli setup-adb          (downloads Google's official platform-tools)

Options:
  -s, --serial <id>          device to use (if more than one is connected)
  --adb <path>               path to adb(.exe)
  --size-only                compare size only (not the date)
  --no-dst                   do not ignore differences of exactly 1 hour
  --overwrite-conflicts      also overwrite files that are newer on the PC
  --exclude <pattern>        additional exclusion (repeatable), e.g. --exclude "WhatsApp/Media/.Statuses/"
  --no-default-excludes      do not apply the default exclusions
  --parallel <1-4>           parallel transfers (default 2)
  --stall <seconds>          stall timeout, minimum 1 (default 30): the stalled file goes back to the end of the queue
  --align-dates <level>      files with the same name and size but a different date: align the date on the PC
                             none = no (default) | size = size only
                             quick = check first+last 64 KB (MD5) | full = full MD5 check
  --retries <n>              extra retries per file (default 5)
  --wait-device <seconds>    maximum wait for reconnection (default 300)
  --verify                   MD5 verification of every copied file
  --diagnostic               save the complete file-by-file lists in the logs folder
  --lang <code>              message language (it, en, ... = file lang\<code>.json); default: the one chosen in the GUI
  --list                     (compare) list the files to copy
  --yes                      (sync) do not ask for confirmation

Exit codes: 0 = all done, 1 = errors on some files, 2 = aborted or incomplete scan, 3 = usage/startup error.
Data (settings, logs, platform-tools): in the program folder (portable).
strings.Scegli la cartella sul telefono: Choose the folder on the phone
strings.Un modello per riga. Esempi:\r\n .thumb:
One pattern per line. Examples:
  .thumbnails/        → excludes every folder with this name
  *.tmp               → excludes files with this name/extension
  WhatsApp/Media/.Statuses/   → with an inner '/': path from the folder chosen on the phone
  ** = any subfolder, * = any text, ? = one character. Lines starting with # are comments.

Defaults: .thumbnails/ (thumbnails regenerated by Android), .trashed-* (recycle bin), .pending-* (files being written). Rules apply from the folder chosen on the phone: if you choose /sdcard/Pictures/.thumbnails directly, its files are NOT excluded. Excluded files remain visible with the "Excluded" filter.
